title: BoundaryReport
description: What the sandbox verified before the worker started.

kind.description: `container`, `bubblewrap` or `none` (the last only in test builds).

ok.description: True only if every required check passed.

egress.description: Egress as the Kit can know it: always `open` today; it cannot be verified closed.

Check.description: One boundary check and its result.

required.description: Whether a failure refuses the run (`true`) or is only reported.

detail.description: What was observed. Names only for anything credential-shaped; never a value.
